guidebook.intro: Yogera ku budde: enkuba, omusana, empewo n’ebiseera by’omwaka.

tips.title: Olungereza lukozesa “it”
body: Mu Luganda enkuba ye ekola: **enkuba etonnya**. Mu Lungereza otandika ne **it**: **It is raining.** **It is hot.** **It is cold today.**

tips.title: Ebiseera by’omwaka
body: **The rainy season** ye ttoggo, **the dry season** kye kyeya. Kozesa **in the**: **In the rainy season there is a lot of rain.**
Mu nsi ezimu waliwo ebiseera bina: **spring, summer, autumn, winter**.

culture.title: Okutandika emboozi
body: Aboogera Olungereza batera okutandika emboozi n’obudde: **Nice weather today!** oba **It’s so hot!** Kiba kirungi okuddamu: **Yes, it is!**
